# asc_vm_groups (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of all virtual machine groups in the ASC platform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `vm_groups` (Attributes List) List of virtual machine groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vm_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--vm_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vm_groups`

Read-Only:

- `attached_volumes` (List of String) The list of volume names attached to the virtual machine group.
- `autoscaling_policy` (Attributes) The autoscaling policy configured for the virtual machine group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vm_groups--autoscaling_policy))
- `last_error` (String) The last error encountered during CRUD of the virtual machine group.
- `name` (String) The name of the virtual machine group.
- `sku` (Attributes) The SKU of the virtual machines in the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vm_groups--sku))
- `status` (String) The current status of the virtual machine group.
- `tags` (Map of String) User defined tags attached to the virtual machine group.
- `urn` (String) The uniform resource name for the virtual machine group.

<a id="nestedatt--vm_groups--autoscaling_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vm_groups.autoscaling_policy`

Read-Only:

- `cron` (Attributes) Cron-based scheduling configuration for scaling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vm_groups--autoscaling_policy--cron))
- `max_replicas` (Number) The maximum number of replicas in the group.
- `min_replicas` (Number) The minimum number of replicas in the group.

<a id="nestedatt--vm_groups--autoscaling_policy--cron"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vm_groups.autoscaling_policy.cron`

Read-Only:

- `desired_replicas` (Number) The desired number of replicas during the scaling window.
- `end` (String) The cron expression marking the end of the scaling window.
- `start` (String) The cron expression marking the start of the scaling window.
- `timezone` (String) The timezone the cron schedule is evaluated in.



<a id="nestedatt--vm_groups--sku"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vm_groups.sku`

Read-Only:

- `cores` (Number) The number of cores.
- `family` (String) The family of the SKU.
- `gpu_count` (Number) The number of GPUs.
- `gpu_type` (String) The type of GPU.
- `id` (String) The ID of the SKU.
- `memory_in_mb` (Number) The amount of memory in MB.
- `name` (String) The name of the SKU.
- `storage_in_gb` (Number) The amount of storage in GB.
- `storage_type` (String) The type of storage.
- `threads` (Number) The number of threads.
